descrição do parâmetro: Value added to the diagonal of the kernel matrix during fitting. This can prevent a potential numerical issue during fitting, by ensuring that the calculated values form a positive definite matrix. It can also be interpreted as the variance of additional Gaussian measurement noise on the training observations.
observações: If an array is passed, it must have the same number of entries as the data used for fitting and is used as datapoint-dependent noise level.

descrição do parâmetro: Constant that multiplies the regularization term if regularization is used.
observações: Only used if penalty is not None.

descrição do parâmetro: Constant that multiplies the regularization term.
observações: The higher the value, the stronger the regularization. Also used for learning rate when learning_rate='optimal'.

descrição do parâmetro: Strength of the squared L2 regularization. Note that the penalty is equal to alpha * ||w||^2.
observações: Must be in the range [0, inf).

descrição do parâmetro: Strength of the L2 regularization term.
observações: The L2 regularization term is divided by the sample size when added to the loss.

descrição do parâmetro: The regularization parameter: the higher alpha, the more regularization, the sparser the inverse covariance. Range is (0, inf].
The highest uncorrected p-value for features to keep.
Clamping factor. A value in (0, 1) that specifies the relative amount that an instance should adopt the information from its neighbors as opposed to its initial label.
observações: alpha=0 means keeping the initial label information; alpha=1 means replacing all initial information.

descrição do parâmetro: The alpha-quantile of huber loss and quantile loss functions.
observações: Only if loss='huber' or loss='quantile'. Values must be in (0.0, 1.0).

descrição do parâmetro: A distance scaling parameter as used in robust single linkage. See [3] for more information.
Hyperparameter of the ridge regression that learns the inverse transform (when fit_inverse_transform=True).
Sparsity controlling parameter. Higher values lead to sparser components.

Constant that multiplies the penalty terms. alpha = 0 is equivalent to ordinary least square. For numerical reasons, using alpha = 0 with the Lasso object is not advised - use LinearRegression instead.
observações: Controls the overall strength of regularization. Higher values increase regularization.

descrição do parâmetro: Constant that multiplies the L1 term, controlling regularization strength. alpha must be a non-negative float i.e. in [0, inf). When alpha = 0, the objective is equivalent to ordinary least squares, solved by the LinearRegression object. For numerical reasons, using alpha = 0 with the Lasso object is not advised. Instead, you should use the LinearRegression object.
Constant that multiplies the L1/L2 term.

Regularization strength; must be a positive float. Regularization improves the conditioning of the problem and reduces the variance of the estimates. Larger values specify stronger regularization. Alpha corresponds to 1 / (2C) in other linear models such as LogisticRegression or LinearSVC.
Constant that multiplies the penalty term.
observações: alpha = 0 is equivalent to an ordinary least square, solved by LinearRegression. For numerical reasons, using alpha = 0 with the LassoLars object is not advised.

descrição do parâmetro: Regularization constant that multiplies the L1 penalty term.
Constant that multiplies the L2 term, controlling regularization strength. alpha must be a non-negative float i.e. in [0, inf).
observações: When alpha = 0, the objective is equivalent to ordinary least squares. For numerical reasons, using alpha = 0 with the Ridge object is not advised.

descrição do parâmetro: Regularization strength; must be a positive float.
observações: Regularization improves the conditioning of the problem and reduces the variance of the estimates. Larger values specify stronger regularization. Alpha corresponds to 1 / (2C) in other linear models such as LogisticRegression or LinearSVC. If an array is passed, penalties are assumed to be specific to the targets.

descrição do parâmetro: Constant that multiplies the L1/L2 term. Defaults to 1.0.
Constant that multiplies the L2 penalty term and determines the regularization strength.
observações: alpha = 0 is equivalent to unpenalized GLMs. In this case, the design matrix X must have full column rank (no collinearities). Values of alpha must be in the range [0.0, inf).

descrição do parâmetro: Sparsity controlling parameter.
Additive (Laplace/Lidstone) smoothing parameter (set alpha=0 and force_alpha=True, for no smoothing).
Sparsity controlling parameter.
Sparsity controlling parameter.
observações: Higher values lead to sparser components.

descrição do parâmetro: Weights associated with classes.
observações: 'balanced' adjusts weights inversely proportional to class frequencies. Added in 0.17.

descrição do parâmetro: If True, X will be copied; else may be overwritten.
observações: Recommended to keep as True to preserve original data.

descrição do parâmetro: When set to True, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit as initialization, otherwise, just erase the previous solution.
observações: Useful for successive fitting with slightly different parameters or data.

descrição do parâmetro: Number of CPUs for OVA computation in multi-class problems.
observações: None means 1, -1 means using all processors.
